scripts.dev: npx concurrently --raw "npm --prefix api-evolution run dev:server" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: node scripts/sync-env.js && npx concurrently --raw "npm --prefix api-evolution install" "npm --prefix backend install" "npm --prefix frontend install"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npx tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && npm --prefix api-evolution exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix api-evolution run lint:check
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix api-evolution run lint
